title: Pre-Sale Prep | Rosa's Sparkling Clean & Management
metaDescription: Deep cleaning, staging and minor repairs that get a property photo-ready and keep it that way through showings, in Ocala, Tampa and Spring Hill, FL.
h1: Show-ready listings that sell for more, faster.
intro: Pre-Sale prep gets a listing photo-ready and keeps it that way through showings, so buyers see the property at its best from the first photo to closing day.

cta.heading: Listing soon? Let's get it show-ready
cta.body: Send us the address and your listing date on WhatsApp — we'll plan the prep around it.

sections.heading: Who it's for
sections.body: Homeowners and real estate agents preparing a listing — including long-vacant properties that need more than a quick clean before they go on the market.
